label: Formulated psychological connectedness and non-identity problem in Reasons and Persons
description: Derek Parfit formulated and introduced the concept of "Psychological Reductionism of Personal Identity", which became a seminal contribution in mind philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in mind.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Contemporary & Post-Structural as part of Derek Parfit's canonical writings.
